newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks bounce back in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks bounce back in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks bounced back in early Thursday morning trade from the prior day's weakness, helped by an overnight rise on Wall Street and a more stable currency market after Wednesday's volatile moves, brokers said.
They said that arbitrage-linked activity and index-linked buying were boosting the indices, while short-covering in banking issues was also providing support.
As of 0015 GMT, the Nikkei average was up 212.92 points or 1.05 percent at 20,502.85. June Nikkei futures rose 240 to 20,550.
